mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at the Verona Area High School, a waxing gibbous moon, and the ISS is passing overhead, though you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will drop to a low of 50 degrees with no rain predicted.

City Hall has announced that crack filling road maintenance will begin on Monday, September 28. Work will take place in five designated areas throughout Verona, and while roads will remain open, drivers should be prepared for potential lane closures and traffic control. Please reach out to Public Works if you have any questions.

There is plenty happening in town. Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, trivia options are plentiful with games at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's. On September 23, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's or visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market.

In a report from September 5, officers investigated a local viral prank where multiple vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields throughout several city streets. No property damage was reported as a result of this incident.
Culver's is currently closed for a scheduled remodel, so they will not be serving their flavor of the day at this time.
